records.text: Tony Burke's Australian ban automatically barred Candace Owens from New Zealand until a New Zealand minister reversed it.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They have a reciprocal system, which is weird. But if Australia bans you, you get automatically banned in New Zealand. So New Zealand didn't actually ban me. Tony Burke in Australia banned me and they have some weird reciprocal system. Then when they found out their minister and his name was Chris something, I should remember it, was like, I'm just against this and he reversed it.

verification.notes: Immigration New Zealand refused Owens's entertainer work visa because New Zealand law bars visas to people excluded by another country; Associate Immigration Minister Chris Penk then exercised discretion to grant a visa after considering free speech. Tony Burke had made the underlying Australian refusal.

sources.title: AP: New Zealand official reverses Candace Owens visa refusal
sources.relevance: Confirms the Australia-triggered refusal and Chris Penk's discretionary reversal.
